43465-the-kangaroo-hunters-or-adventures.description: A book by Anne Bowman,. and pages of syntax, by fanciful adventures amidst scenes of novelty and peril, and returns to his labors refreshed, to the over-tasked man of study or science, who wades through his days and nights of toil, cheered by the prospect of a holiday of voyaging or travelling over new scenes.

arxiv-2110-05843.title: FAST BLOCK LINEAR SYSTEM SOLVER USING Q-LEARNING SCHEDULING FOR UNIFIED DYNAMIC POWER SYSTEM SIMULATIONS
arxiv-2110-05843.creator: Yingshi Chen, Xinli Song, HanYang Dai, Tao Liu, Wuzhi Zhong, Guoyang Wu
arxiv-2110-05843.description: Abstract We present a fast block direct solver for the unified dynamic simulations of power systems. This solver uses a novel Q-learning based method for task scheduling. Unified dynamic simulations of power systems represent a method in which the electric-mechanical transient, medium-term and long-term dynamic phenomena are organically united.

arxiv-2110-14434.title: Nonnegative Tucker Decomposition with Beta-divergence for Music Structure Analysis of Audio Signals
arxiv-2110-14434.creator: \coord AxelMarmoret1, \coord FlorianVoorwinden1, \coord ValentinLeplat2, \coord Jérémy E.Cohen3, \coord FredericBimbot1
arxiv-2110-14434.description: Abstract \frenchabstract La décomposition en Tucker nonnégatif (NTD), un modèle de décomposition tensorielle, permet d’extraire des motifs pertinents de manière non-supervisée, notamment dans le cadre de signaux audios. Néanmoins, les algorithmes actuels pour calculer la NTD sont souvent conçus pour optimiser la norme euclidienne.

arxiv-2205-06555.title: Quantum control of tunable-coupling transmons using dynamical invariants of motion
arxiv-2205-06555.creator: H. Espinós, I. Panadero, J. J. García-Ripoll, E. Torrontegui
arxiv-2205-06555.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by H. Espinós, I. Panadero, J. J. García-Ripoll, E. Torrontegui. We analyse the implementation of a fast nonadiabatic CZ gate between two transmon qubits with tuneable coupling. The gate control method is based on a theory of dynamical invariants which leads to reduced leakage and robustness against decoherence. The gate is based on a description of the resonance between the | 11 ⟩ \ket{11} and | 20 ⟩ \ket{20} using an effective Hamiltonian with the 6 lowest energy states.

arxiv-2312-12146.title: Deviation of top eigenvalue for some tridiagonal matrices under various moment assumptions Thanks: Supported by EPSRC grant EP/W524141/1.
arxiv-2312-12146.creator: Yi HAN
arxiv-2312-12146.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yi HAN. Symmetric tridiagonal matrices appear ubiquitously in mathematical physics, serving as the matrix representation of discrete random Schrödinger operators. In this work we investigate the top eigenvalue of these matrices in the large deviation regime, assuming the random potentials are on the diagonal with a certain decaying factor N − α N^{-\alpha} , and the probability law μ \mu of the potentials satisfy specific decay assumptions.

arxiv-2410-19317.title: FairMT-Bench: Benchmarking Fairness for Multi-turn Dialogue in Conversational LLMs
arxiv-2410-19317.creator: Zhiting Fan †, Ruizhe Chen †, Tianxiang Hu †, Zuozhu Liu
arxiv-2410-19317.description: Abstract The increasing deployment of large language model (LLM)-based chatbots has raised concerns regarding fairness. Fairness issues in LLMs may result in serious consequences, such as bias amplification, discrimination, and harm to minority groups. Many efforts are dedicated to evaluating and mitigating biases in LLMs.

arxiv-2506-05635.title: IYKYK: Using language models to decode extremist cryptolects
arxiv-2506-05635.creator: Christine de Kock, Arij Riabi, Zeerak Talat, Michael Sejr Schlichtkrull, Pranava Madhyastha, Eduard Hovy
arxiv-2506-05635.description: Abstract Extremist groups develop complex in-group language, also referred to as cryptolects , to exclude or mislead outsiders. We investigate the ability of current language technologies to detect and interpret the cryptolects of two online extremist platforms. Evaluating eight models across six tasks, our results indicate that general purpose LLMs cannot consistently detect or decode extremist language.

arxiv-2508-02607.title: On a multiplicative non-Hecke twist of motivic L-functions
arxiv-2508-02607.creator: Heiko Knospe, Andrzej Dąbrowski
arxiv-2508-02607.description: Abstract . We investigate the twisting of motivic L L -functions by a family of multiplicative characters ψ \psi , defined on prime ideals 𝔭 \mathfrak{p} via ψ ⁡ ( p ) = α N ⁡ ( 𝔭 ) \psi(p)=\alpha^{N(\mathfrak{p})} for a fixed α ∈ ℂ \alpha\in\mathbb{C} .

arxiv-2509-01984.title: Discrete Noise Inversion for Next-scale Autoregressive Text-based Image Editing
arxiv-2509-01984.creator: Quan Dao, Xiaoxiao He, Ligong Han, Ngan Hoai Nguyen, Amin Heyrani Nobari, Faez Ahmed, Han Zhang, Viet Anh Nguyen, Dimitris Metaxas
arxiv-2509-01984.description: Abstract Visual autoregressive models (VAR) have recently emerged as a promising class of generative models, achieving performance comparable to diffusion models in text-to-image generation tasks. While conditional generation has been widely explored, the ability to perform prompt-guided image editing without additional training is equally critical, as it supports numerous practical real-world applications.

pmc-10876036.title: Adults’ perceived health promotion needs in the prediabetes stage: a meta-synthesis study
pmc-10876036.creator: MOZHGAN JOKAR, MITRA ZANDI, ABBAS EBADI, AMIR ABBAS MOMENAN, MARIANO MARTINI, MASOUD BEHZADIFAR
pmc-10876036.description: SummaryIntroductionOne of the methods to promote pre-diabetic patients’ adherence to preventive behaviors and improving their lifestyle is to pay attention to their needs in the designed educational programs. Therefore, this study was conducted with the aim of identifying the needs of individuals with prediabetes.MethodologyThree databases, including ISI/Web of Sciences, PubMed, Scopus were searched without time limitation until August 2022.

pmc-11318487.title: Benefits of intensive lipid-lowering therapies in patients with acute coronary syndrome: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11318487.creator: Xian-Dan Wu, Xin-Yue Ye, Xuan-Yan Liu, Yue Lin, Xian Lin, Yan-Yan Li, Bin-Hua Ye, Jing-Chao Sun
pmc-11318487.description: BackgroundPrevious meta-analyses have investigated the efficacy of lipid-lowering therapies for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease; however, few have focused on patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS). This meta-analysis aimed to compare the benefits of intensive lipid-lowering therapy with those of background statin therapy in patients with ACS.MethodsSearches were performed on PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, and ClinicalTrials.

pmc-11674712.title: The Role of Activated Stromal Cells in Fibrotic Foci Formation and Reversion
pmc-11674712.creator: Nataliya Andreevna Basalova, Maksim Alexandrovich Vigovskiy, Vladimir Sergeevich Popov, Evgeniya Alexandrovna Lagereva, Olga Alexandrovna Grigorieva, Anastasia Yuryevna Efimenko
pmc-11674712.description: Fibrotic focus is a pivotal morphofunctional unit in developing fibrosis in various tissues. For most fibrotic diseases, including progressive forms, the foci are considered unable to remodel and contribute to the worsening of prognosis. Unfortunately, the dynamics of the fibrotic focus formation and resolution remains understudied.

pmc-12395289.title: PNI as a predictive biomarker: a novel nomogram of immunotherapy efficacy in advanced breast cancer
pmc-12395289.creator: Xinyang Li, Xiang Cheng, Yikai Han, Xiaodan Liu, Yujin Fang, Shengju Ren, Xiangwen Dong, Ziwen Lei, Yue Zhang, Tengfei Zhang
pmc-12395289.description: PurposeThere has been a persistent upward trend in breast cancer (BC) incidence in recent years. The advancement of immunotherapy has introduced promising therapeutic options. This study focuses on identify potential biomarkers to predict clinical outcomes in advanced BC patients receiving immunotherapy.

pmc-12532402.title: Association between lipid profiles and early clinical outcomes in acute ischemic stroke: a single-center cohort study in the Chinese population
pmc-12532402.creator: Duanlu Hou, Yuanyuan Wang, Shuang Zhai, Xiaoli Yang, Yuping Tang, Danhong Wu
pmc-12532402.description: BackgroundThe clinical significance and contribution of the lipid profile in atherosclerosis are well established. However, further investigation is needed in stroke patients, particularly regarding apolipoprotein B100 (ApoB100), a novel non-traditional lipid component in the lipid profile.ObjectivesTo explore lipid parameters and their impact on stroke outcomes in patients with and without thrombolysis.

pmc-12650674.title: Assessment of Risk Factors for Cognitive Impairment Accounting for Genetic and Environmental Influences: An Italian Population-Based Twin Study
pmc-12650674.creator: Emanuela Medda, Nicola Vanacore, Marco Canevelli, Francesco Sciancalepore, Elisa Fabrizi, Nicoletta Locuratolo, Filippo Nuti, Corrado Fagnani, Takao Yamasaki, Yang Zhang
pmc-12650674.description: Background/Objectives: The etiology of dementia is complex and multifactorial, with both genetic and environmental factors contributing to its onset. The Lancet Commission has identified several risk factors for this condition, but it is increasingly urgent to confirm their etiological role while accounting for both measured and unmeasured confounding effects.

pmc-12821885.title: Progressive curriculum learning with Scale-Enhanced U-Net for continuous airway segmentation
pmc-12821885.creator: Bingyu Yang, Qingyao Tian, Huai Liao, Xinyan Huang, Jinlin Wu, Jingdi Hu, Hongbin Liu
pmc-12821885.description: Continuous and accurate segmentation of airways in chest CT images is essential for preoperative planning and real-time bronchoscopy navigation. Despite advances in deep learning for medical image segmentation, maintaining airway continuity remains a challenge, particularly due to intra-class imbalance between large and small branches and blurred CT details.

pmc-12958231.title: Optimizing Performance Monitoring of Value-Based Healthcare: The Role of Generic Patient Population Dashboards
pmc-12958231.creator: Marieke Sijm-Eeken, Jurrien Burren, Céline van Lint
pmc-12958231.description: Value-based healthcare (VBHC) provides a framework for enhancing health outcomes relative to costs, however its implementation depends on robust and inclusive performance monitoring systems. In their recent scoping review, van Elten et al examined the role of performance management in VBHC but adopted a narrow focus on patient-perceived outcomes.

pmc-13166402.title: Evaluating a transdisciplinary supportive care model for advanced liver disease: Results of the Liver Life pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT)
pmc-13166402.creator: Sarah Pullen, Tazeen Majeed, Sarah Russo, Mary-Anne Dieckmann, Christopher Oldmeadow, Olivia Wynne, Caroline Kuhne, Jane Kerr, John Attia, Katie Wynne
pmc-13166402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesPatients with advanced liver disease (ALD) may benefit from the early integration of supportive care toward the end of life. Engagement with supportive and palliative care could decrease disease-related distress and alleviate pressure on the health system.

pmc-13236095.title: Reconciliation in the context of communities in crisis
pmc-13236095.creator: Malek Batal, Geneviève Mercille, Lynn Barwin, Caralynn Berti, Laurie H.M. Chan, Amy Ing, Tom Kovesi, Ariane Lafortune, Mélanie Lemire, Lili Miller, Milena Nardocci, Alexandrine Roy, Tonio Sadik, Curtis Scurr, Jolian Wong
pmc-13236095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). critical constraint that recent experience has made undeniable: these conditions cannot be realized when communities are repeatedly pushed into crisis. Our team, conducting the FEHNCY (Food, Environment, Health and Nutrition of First Nations Children and Youth) study in partnership with the Assembly of First Nations, was forced to postpone planned research with Pimicikamak Cree Nation twice, first because of wildfires, then a catastrophic winter power outage that led to widespread infrastructure failure and evacuation.2,3 In both instances, survival needs took precedence.

pmc-13400175.title: Core gastric microbiota linked to pathogenesis and preserved across age-stratified cohorts
pmc-13400175.creator: Weidong Huang, Qiujin Chen, Xuejie Gao, Gaocheng Yi, Yongyuan Su, Jiayi Shen, Tao Zhang, Hao Zhang, Yanbin Chen, Yingying Yu, Wen Wang, Hewei Jiang, Xu Lin, Zhaowei Xu
pmc-13400175.description: SummaryThe stomach harbors a complex microbial niche, yet the persistence and disease relevance of its core microbiota remain unclear. Using full-length 16S and ITS sequencing of 255 pediatric samples, this study identifies 11 core bacterial genera organized into two antagonistic communities, CST1A and CST1B.

pmc-13588301.title: Estimating Radiation Dose and Proposing Institutional Diagnostic Reference Levels for Paediatric Fluoroscopy of Micturating Cystourethrogram: Age- and Weight - Specific Comparisons
pmc-13588301.creator: Khalid M. Aloufi
pmc-13588301.description: SummaryObjective:To compare age- and weight-specific methods used to estimate radiation doses and to propose institutional diagnostic reference levels (DRLs) for paediatric fluoroscopy of micturating cystourethrogram (MCUG).Methods:In this retrospective study, MCUG fluoroscopy parameters were gathered for 100 paediatric patients from July 2025 to January 2026. The data included the MCUG paediatric procedures for patients aged 0–15 years.
